videos.title: #Dead2Me
videos.description: Simon Gilchrist was a loving Dad and partner to his girlfriend Caroline Mawhood; tragically, his life would be cut short by the very person he devoted his life to.

videos.title: #Dead2Me
videos.description: Bennylyn Burke hoped for a better life when she moved from the Philippines to the UK, but she ended up the victim of a cruel predator who would take her life.

videos.title: #Dead2Me
videos.description: Terri Harris was a loving mom who had no way of knowing that the man she'd met online had a dangerous history of crime, violence and abuse; he would go on to embark on a shocking murder spree that would leave him branded a psychopath.

videos.title: #Dead2Me
videos.description: Jennifer Poole's life tragically changed when she met Gavin Murphy; over the course of their relationship, Jennifer became subdued and distant; it was only after her brutal murder that her family uncovered Murphy's appalling treatment of Jennifer.

videos.title: #Dead2Me
videos.description: Tai O'Donnell was a talented musician, but his ambitions were cruelly cut short after he met Kamila Ahmad; Kamila managed to hide her violent past and keep control of Tai, and when he tried to leave, she stopped him in the most brutal way possible.

videos.title: Murder at First Swipe
videos.description: Unravel the web of lies that allowed a dating-app killer to hide in plain sight.

videos.title: Murder Rap: Inside the Biggie and Tupac Murders
videos.description: A look at the murders of rap stars Tupac Shakur and Biggie Smalls including the investigations, speculations, conspiracy theories and interviews.

videos.title: The Real Manhunter
videos.description: Colin Sutton recounts the investigation into an attack against a popular couple, who were stabbed in their own Camden home by a man whom they had long treated like their own son.

videos.title: The Real Manhunter
videos.description: A reclusive millionaire living in London, Allan Chappelow was a writer and photographer murdered by Chinese dissident and MI6 informant Wang Yam in an apparent identity theft scheme.

videos.title: The Real Manhunter
videos.description: Iain Lawrence appears to be a successful businessman and a loving husband; however, his wife's death in a car accident reveals a different side to his life.

videos.title: The Real Manhunter
videos.description: Colin Sutton and his team make a discovery when they investigate the case of "EastEnders" actress Sian Blake, who went missing with her two children in December 2015.

videos.title: The Real Manhunter
videos.description: Michael Danaher writes a list of famous and wealthy targets, but his plans result in murder when he stabs historian and art dealer Adrian Greenwood to death.

videos.title: The Real Manhunter
videos.description: James Fairweather becomes a double killer aged just 15 when he stabs James Attfield and Nahid Almanea, leading some to suspect that his interest in serial killers played a role.
